# Start Scaling Barriers

Source: [wiki article 4507](../archive/4507.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Start Scaling Barriers](../../api/actions/start-scaling-barriers.md).

<a id="wiki-4507-n1"></a>

- Barrier scale is a multiplier (0.5 halves, 2 doubles); enabled reevaluation updates every frame, otherwise scale is sampled once.
